title: Treat AI like a brilliant freelancer with amnesia
caption: It knows every trade and forgets you every time, so every job starts from day one.
description: Name the five traits that make AI costly, and manage them with five moves: break it down, requirements first, interview yourself with AI, evaluate each step, and a fresh start for each piece.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.script: Welcome to hancrafted. Today's episode is about why you should treat AI like a brilliant freelancer with amnesia. The goal: a fresh perspective, so the next time AI leaves you confused or disappointed, you have a mental model to solve it. Let's get going.

junior-to-freelancer.description: The announcement spoke of a junior analogy, the Slides say “freelancer”. Say the bridge out loud: “Picture the AI as a new colleague, more an experienced freelancer than a junior: it knows an incredible amount, but it forgets everything after each conversation.”
